text:
maya (Marketing): kicking off a Developer Ignite mini-workshop + tutorial series next month. idea: 3 live sessions, one mini refapp repo, plus a short benchmark writeup to lead into signups. target = 500 dev leads. initial ask: quick thoughts on format and routing? :sparkles:
sam (DevRel): love it. keep sessions super practical — 20m demo, 15m benchmark walkthrough, 10m q&a. we should surface a simple benchmark narrative: throughput/cost tradeoffs for small apps. also a short refapp that shows local->dedicated deploy flow. :thumbsup:
tori (Content): i can draft a 2-week drip + short tutorial series outline: teaser post, tutorial 1 (local dev + run), tutorial 2 (embed + API best practices), tutorial 3 (cost tuning + rollout). need repo + starter prompts. can someone spin up a minimal template repo? :eyes:
zane (Growth): routing: separate landing page per session (utm_session=1/2/3), and a single 'try credits' flow in HubSpot. score leads by engagement (attended session + downloaded refapp = high intent). add a checkbox for 'interested in Dedicated' to route to sales SDR. I'll map the funnel if we agree.
maya (Marketing): ok — i'll create landing page drafts and CTAs. sam, can you own the benchmark config + demo script? tori, send the tutorial skeleton by EOD Thursday. zane, draft the inbound mapping and share with growth team. i'll handle social copy + email drip. :rocket:
sam (DevRel): i can own benchmark. proposed quick demo commands below so content team can screenshot numbers:
```
# local run for demo
python run_benchmark.py --model redwood-7b --seq 512 --batch 8 --warmup 50 --steps 500
# metrics to show: p50 latency, tokens/sec, cost_per_1k_tokens
```
will also include a 10-min 'how we tuned batching & cache' section for the live workshop.
tori (Content): sample hero copy for landing page draft: 'Build, benchmark, and ship LLM features fast with Redwood — join our 3-part Developer Ignite series.' i'll put up the tutorial TOC in the doc now. also creating a short 'getting started' gist for the refapp.
zane (Growth): for HubSpot properties i suggest: source=dev-ignite, session_number, attended:boolean, downloaded_refapp:boolean, interested_dedicated:boolean. then automation: attended + downloaded => assign to mid-market SDR. i'll attach a first-pass flow after lunch.
maya (Marketing): timeline check: landings + hubspot flows by next Wed, content drafts by Thu, repo + demo by Fri, dry run the week before. is that achievable?
sam (DevRel): yes for me. i'll push the demo config to a branch and tag tori.
tori (Content): yep, i'll have drafts by Thu and a ready PR for the getting-started gist by Friday.
deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: 'Dev Ignite planning sync' at 2026-04-02 10:00 PT — invite sent to maya, sam, tori, zane.
maya (Marketing): awesome — thanks everyone. i'll post a short checklist in #marketing when landing pages are live. :white_check_mark:
